name: MindSet
headline: MindSet
description: A complex of amino acids, B vitamins and extracts of ginkgo biloba, gotu kola, ginger root and St John's wort. Together they support blood supply and nourishment of the brain, memory and attention, while reishi mushroom helps protect nerve cells.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Acetyl-L-carnitine, St John's wort extract, gotu kola leaf extract, tyrosine, theanine, reishi fruiting body extract, reishi mycelium extract, lipoic acid, ginger root extract, ginkgo biloba leaf extract, rosemary leaf extract, vitamins B6 and B12, folic acid, excipients.
